name: pytest
covers: Rerail's own pytest rules, from the pytest docs and maintainers' review advice, for isolated tests, sound fixtures and mocks that check what they claim.

rules.title: pytest practice: test code changes django.conf.settings directly

caught.text:
from django.conf import settings


def test_svg_upload_sanitized(client):
    settings.SVG_SECURITY_CLEANUP = True
    response = client.post("/upload", {"file": "x.svg"})
    assert response.status_code == 201

passes.text:
def test_svg_upload_sanitized(client, settings):
    settings.SVG_SECURITY_CLEANUP = True
    response = client.post("/upload", {"file": "x.svg"})
    assert response.status_code == 201

rules.title: pytest practice: test code changes os.environ without undoing it
pytest practice: test code changes a module global or class attribute without undoing it

caught.text:
from shop import checkoutflow


def test_flow_order(event):
    checkoutflow.DEFAULT_FLOW = (checkoutflow.ConfirmStep, checkoutflow.PaymentStep)
    flow = checkoutflow.get_checkout_flow(event)
    assert flow[0].priority <= flow[1].priority

passes.text:
from shop import checkoutflow


def test_flow_order(event, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(checkoutflow, "DEFAULT_FLOW", (checkoutflow.ConfirmStep, checkoutflow.PaymentStep))
    flow = checkoutflow.get_checkout_flow(event)
    assert flow[0].priority <= flow[1].priority

rules.title: pytest practice: stacked @patch mock parameters named in decorator order, so each holds the other's mock
pytest practice: a mock patch on the defining module of a name its callers imported with from-import

with.text:
def send_email(to, body):
